_comment: Project-owned scenario suite (M4/§6/§11). Each scenario has a deterministic generator (seeded), an episode-labelled truth (entities+roles+behavior), and a matched benign control. `set` splits development (tune/build) from holdout (frozen effectiveness eval) — never tune on holdout. `status` is honest about what is validated vs pending: `validated`=detector fires + finding delivered on a real run; `built`=generator+truth ship, detection not yet confirmed; `needs-corpus`=requires an external labelled PCAP (prevalence); `needs-live`=requires the Mode-2 live-capture lab; `needs-ad`=requires an AD/Windows east-west lab. All attack rows are HYPOTHESES to test, not guaranteed detections (§6).

S01.name: periodic callbacks (beacon)
S01.question: beacon detection adds signal without flagging every periodic service

S02.name: jittered callbacks
S02.question: sensitivity persists across preregistered jitter ranges

S03.name: one callback domain, rotating destinations (FQDN beacon)
S03.question: domain aggregation works and stays selective
S03.note: detector aggregates to the registered domain (evil.example); finding also carries src ip so the episode matches

S04.name: internal scan + lateral fan-out
S04.question: related events consolidated; contextual limits exposed
S04.note: two episodes (recon scan + lateral fan-out) on 10.0.0.8 — detectors emit discovery + lateral (§7 multiple-episodes-per-host)

S05.name: many small outbound transfers (cumulative exfil)
S05.question: cumulative exfil distinguished from normal transfer

S06.name: encoded subdomains under one parent (DNS tunnel)
S06.question: tunneling sensitivity balanced against DNS false positives

S07.name: signature-triggering lab traffic
S07.question: a valid Suricata detection is preserved through Cernity
S07.note: uses a local demonstration rule (deploy/benchmark/suricata/local.rules); pipeline-preservation, not malware accuracy

S08.name: repeated behavioural C2 beacons (dedup)
S08.question: beacon dedup reduces repetition without hiding a second incident
S08.note: two distinct C2 beacons: both surface (recall 2/2), 40 connections -> ~4 findings. This is BEHAVIOURAL-beacon dedup, not signature repetition — the name was corrected (handoff stage 6); the distinct signature-repetition case is S13 (proposed).

S13.name: repeated signature alerts + a new signature incident
S13.question: does signature-alert dedup collapse repeats without hiding a genuinely new signature incident
S13.note: PROPOSED (handoff stage 6): needs a generator that emits one ET-Open-matching signature repeated many times PLUS a distinct new signature incident. Not yet built; the S08 case is behavioural, so this signature case is genuinely missing coverage.

S09.name: scan -> lateral -> callbacks (correlation)
S09.question: correlation adds a justified incident narrative

S10.name: benign-only mixed workload
S10.question: both arms correctly finish with no relevant detections

S11.name: short/sparse/encrypted/unsupported
S11.question: the report admits misses and unavailable evidence
S11.note: expected-MISS scenario: sub-threshold (4 callbacks); recall=0 is the correct 'admits misses' outcome + valid-empty completion

S12.name: duplicate/reordered telemetry, sink outage (resilience)
S12.question: loss, duplication, evidence changes, and recovery are visible
S12.note: fault injection (M5) — kill a sink mid-run, replay duplicates; not a pure offline generator
